sentences.text: The in-force UCB directions say a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges in the covered cases, but they do not state any RBI monetary penalty for levying them.
The earlier foreclosure-charge circulars are superseded and no longer in force on the as-of date.

missing.slot: monetary penalty for prohibited foreclosure charges
missing.searched: Reviewed the in-force UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 and the superseded foreclosure-charge circulars; neither source states an RBI monetary penalty amount for levying prohibited foreclosure charges.
